name: Durable AgentRun Foundation
scope: compatibility-wrapped durable runtime foundation; not the complete multi-turn AgentRunEngine
guarantees: Every legacy Pair Programmer execution obtains a durable run_id before context loading.
Legacy SSE frames are projected into sequenced hash-chained AgentRun events.
Events can be replayed after renderer disconnect or backend restart.
Approval decisions are persisted against an exact run_id and approval_id.
Renderer cancellation reaches the backend AgentRun cancellation endpoint.
Registered asyncio tasks and process handles can be signalled by the cancellation registry.
Restart-orphaned active runs are paused rather than silently reported as live.
honest_limits: POST-created records do not yet launch execution; execution remains compatibility-wrapped through the legacy stream.
Prompt and context transport still uses the legacy GET stream.
Approval presentation still uses the current confirmation UI.
Resume marks a run ready but does not yet reconstruct and relaunch the provider/tool coroutine.
Process-tree cancellation applies only to registered handles.
Automatic renderer replay and timeline reconstruction remain Phase 2B.
Worktree-first iterative edit, test, diagnose, and repair remains Phase 2B/2C.
